context: Tooltip body for the Adaptive camera mode in the view selector's camera mode dropdown. Adaptive lets the editor camera switch between FPS and Orbit mode on its own when the user zooms to parts, as opposed to picking FPS or Orbit to restrict it to that mode.
source: When you zoom to parts, switch camera mode automatically, or restrict to manual only.

values.en-us: When you zoom to parts, switch camera mode automatically, or restrict to manual only.

context: Option in the view selector's camera mode dropdown, and its tooltip title: the editor camera switches between FPS and Orbit mode on its own.
